# attested on carrier

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attestedOnCarrier`](gmeow-attestedOnCarrier.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestedOnCarrier>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The physical archaeological carrier on which an attested form was observed — a tablet, ostracon, seal, coin, manuscript, or wall. NON-FUNCTIONAL: an attestation may reference multiple carriers (e.g. duplicate impressions), and competing carrier attributions coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)). This is the language-facing hook from [`UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) to archaeological evidence.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) -> [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:attestedOnCarrier`](gmeow-attestedOnCarrier.md) from [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) to [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md), [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) to name the physical carrier — tablet, ostracon, seal, coin, manuscript, wall — on which the form was observed, the hook to archaeological evidence.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the bibliographic source ([`gmeow:attestedInSource`](gmeow-attestedInSource.md)) or the abstract context ([`gmeow:attestedInContext`](gmeow-attestedInContext.md)), and avoid forcing one carrier — duplicate impressions coexist, so keep it non-functional.

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:attestedOnCarrier`](gmeow-attestedOnCarrier.md) at one or more [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md) carriers; multiple carriers for one attestation are expected for duplicate or recut inscriptions.

### Examples

- ex:att1 [`gmeow:attestedOnCarrier`](gmeow-attestedOnCarrier.md) ex:tabletK1234.
